# Barbara Shaw

## Overview

- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) (relative), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Barbara Shaw is a tall and awkward girl. She has an gangly demeanor, appearing as though she possesses too many hands and feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Barbara Shaw is an exceedingly clumsy individual, known among the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) scholars for her inability to walk down an aisle without tripping over her own or someone else's feet. She is also prone to minor accidents, such as spilling a dipper of water onto the floor.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000)_

## Traits

- accident-prone  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000)</sub>
- clumsy  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)</sub>

## History

Barbara Shaw came to live with her aunt in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after having previously visited her [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) the prior winter. She became one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's pupils at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) announced her resignation as teacher to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Barbara joined her fellow classmates and friends in feeling sorrowful over Anne's upcoming departure.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), +122 more_

## Relationships

### [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-mary--barbara-shaw.md)

[Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) is Barbara Shaw's aunt. She is mentioned in a student composition that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts in a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), where Barbara writes about her family members.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barbara-shaw--joseph.md)

[Joseph](../character/joseph.md) is Barbara Shaw's uncle. Like [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md), he is brought up in a humorous school composition written by Barbara, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) later describes in her correspondence with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

- Relative of — uncle  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>
